summary: The implementation successfully applies modern gradient styling to the requested dashboard components while preserving the DNA helix background and maintaining accessibility. All requirements are addressed with appropriate evidence in the modified files.

hallucinated_features.description: Addition of gradient utility classes to index.css including gradient-card-amber-subtle, gradient-card-sage-subtle, gradient-card-radial-amber, gradient-card-radial-sage, gradient-panel-amber, and gradient-panel-sage
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest explicitly constrains 'Do not modify...adding new color variables' and states in non-goals 'Modifying color palette or adding new color variables'. While these are utility classes rather than CSS variables, the diff shows new gradient stops (--gradient-amber-start, --gradient-amber-mid, etc.) were added to index.css, which appears to extend the color system beyond what was requested.
